base_en: Teammates linked by Soul Bond receive a Speed Boost.

base_en: Activation grants Reveal within a targeted area. Activating the ability again performs a slam attack; enemies hit by the slam are Grounded.

issue_desc: 영문 원문과 일치함

base_en: Project an Illusion forward. The illusion utilizes Assassin's Charge to thrust at enemies. Enemies struck head-on will be carried through the air for a short while.
enh_en: When teaming up with Loki, the ability gains two charges.
base_ko: 전방으로 환영을 투사합니다. 환영은 암살자의 돌진(Assassin's Charge)을 사용하여 전방의 적을 들이받으며, 정면으로 충돌한 적을 잠시 공중으로 끌고 갑니다.

issue_desc: 영문 원문과 일치함

enh_en: When teaming up with Black Panther, this explosion is no longer restricted by the energy threshold and can be triggered at any time.

issue_desc: 영문 원문과 일치함
